title: Final velocity magnitude
description: Essential: The answer must state the final common speed as 0.4 m/s.

title: Momentum conservation application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply momentum conservation to the block-cart system.

title: Energy loss to friction
description: Important: The solution must equate the work done by kinetic friction to the system's loss in kinetic energy.

title: Minimum length calculation
description: Essential: The answer for the minimum cart length must be 0.4 m.

title: Correct friction force
description: Important: The work-energy step must use the correct kinetic friction force (μmg).

title: Relative motion distance
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly identify the friction work distance as the block's slip length relative to the cart.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the work done by friction is given a positive sign in the energy balance.

title: Unit omission or mismatch
description: Pitfall: Penalize if final answers lack correct units (m/s, m) or use inconsistent units in calculations.
